operations.description: The ratchet's starting point: every command's size as measured on 2026-08-24 (min 47, median 129, max 466, 7338 lines total). Recorded rather than enforced down to 40, because the owner's decision was <=40 for NEW commands with a no-growth ratchet on existing ones -- flat compliance would have been a 5138-line prose rewrite. Also records the two skill_agent_waivers review surfaced: both really do grant `Agent`, so the rule would fail the DoD on day one. Waived by NAME with a reason each -- never by pattern, which would silently cover the next skill someone adds.
